evidence_items.explanation: The study documents full-video descriptions missing the monkey's bag-taking event and weaker model performance than humans; the closed-model access window ended in November 2024. It also reports competitive performance and human preference for model responses on the forecasting task, so the failures do not extend uniformly across tasks.

unresolved_gaps: The study does not isolate a matched ordinary-versus-unusual video penalty.
The experiments do not determine whether retrieval, frame sampling, perception, reasoning or another mechanism caused each error.
These results do not test every model available by June 2025.
